title.value: Scaling Vision-based End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Multi-View Attention Learning
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Scaling Vision-based End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Multi-View Attention Learning

extractions.description: This paper introduces CIL++, an improved vision-based end-to-end autonomous driving model that uses higher-resolution images and an attention mechanism to achieve competitive performance compared to more costly models. It focuses on imitation learning from human driving demonstrations, using vehicle signals for supervision without requiring human-labeled sensor data.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper focuses on autonomous driving, it does not explicitly frame its work within the context of broader sustainable development goals. The focus is primarily on improving the technology of autonomous driving rather than directly addressing environmental or social sustainability issues.

primary_category.justification: The research aims to improve the efficiency and safety of autonomous driving, which can lead to optimized traffic flow, reduced fuel consumption, and lower emissions, contributing to climate change mitigation.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper directly addresses autonomous driving, which falls under the transportation sub-category. The focus is on improving the algorithms and models used for autonomous vehicles.

applications.value: Commercial transportation- optimize freight routing and scheduling
applications.justification: Efficient autonomous driving can optimize routes for commercial transportation, leading to fuel savings and reduced emissions.
The technology developed in the paper can be applied to autonomous buses, improving public transportation efficiency and reducing reliance on personal vehicles.
The research can contribute to improving the energy efficiency of electric vehicles through better driving algorithms and control systems.
